title: Close-out on Default
description:
closeout-default/v1 — the document a closeout-default event carries. The INTERRUPT counterpart of closeout: authored by the valuation engine from any operating state, including with reports still open, and it demands no disposition or verdict from anyone. It moves the agreement to a defaulted state, which is deliberately not final so a default workout has somewhere to happen.

The document is informational: the definition's guard asks only who is emitting.

reason.description: What triggered the default, e.g. a counterparty failure. Free text for the audit trail.
